title: eludite.resx.add input
description: Add a key to a resource set, as the editor's Add Key does (proposal 0005): the entry goes to the end of the neutral file in Visual Studio's shape; the culture files are not touched (their cells show missing). Class edit_buffer, as eludite.resx.set.

set.description: The resource set: the path of its neutral `.resx` file (absolute, or relative to the workspace folder), or of any of its culture files, which names the same set.

key.description: The new key: a name Visual Studio accepts (letters, digits, `_`, `.`, `-`; not already in the set).

invariant.description: Mark the key invariant. Default: false.
